scheme_name: Scheme for Small Business Owners of Scheduled Castes to Buy a Place of Business/Shop
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native of Gujarat.
Applicant must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
Loan must be used only for purchasing or renting a shop/business premises.
The premises must be mortgaged to the government until the loan is fully repaid.
If constructing on one's own land, the land must be uncultivated and title cleared.
Security must be provided by two local persons with immovable property equal to the loan amount.
Illegal activities are prohibited at the business place.
Defaulting on loan incurs penal interest of 2.5% and possible recovery as land revenue arrears.
benefits_summary: Maximum loan of ₹10 lakhs with interest up to 4% and a subsidy of ₹15,000, plus interest subsidy for bank interest above 4% for three years.
